title: ArenaMatch
description: Arena battle record. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.4; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.4 arena_matches. Outcome uses seeded random ±15% modifier (random_seed enables deterministic replay).

petAId.description: Challenger pet id (FK pets.id, ON DELETE RESTRICT for audit integrity).

petBId.description: Opponent pet id. NULL for AI opponents or if the pet row was removed.

isAiOpponent.description: TRUE if the opponent was an AI fallback (used after 30s matchmaking timeout).

winnerPetId.description: Winner pet id. NULL if pet row was removed; tie-break prevents true draws.

randomSeed.description: Seeded random for ±15% modifier reproducibility (deterministic replay).

statDeltaA.description: Net stat value used for petA after buff.

statDeltaB.description: Net stat value used for petB after buff.
